fields.summary: TC-818-01: Stream App Retries COA Processing When Hydration Lambda Returns Non-Null CoaCrewPairing Response

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-818

Precondition: The stream app COA lag fix is deployed. When the Hydration Lambda returns a non-null CoaCrewPairing object, the stream app must join it with the assignment event and publish to the aggregated topic. When Hydration returns null, the stream app must retry by checking the global table.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Trigger a CSS event that causes the stream app to call the Hydration Lambda for pairing data
Valid CSS assignment event published to Kafka assignment topic
Stream app receives the assignment event and calls the Hydration Lambda
Simulate the Hydration Lambda returning a non-null CoaCrewPairing object in the response
Hydration Lambda response: CoaCrewPairing object with trip, DP, leg data populated (non-null)
Stream app receives non-null CoaCrewPairing object from Hydration Lambda
Verify the stream app joins the CoaCrewPairing response with the assignment event and publishes to the aggregated topic
Aggregated topic: int.workforce.aggregatedCrewAssignment.v1.techp
Aggregated message is published containing both pairing data (from non-null Hydration response) and assignment data
Simulate the Hydration Lambda returning null (lag scenario) and verify stream app retries via global table lookup
Hydration Lambda response: null (pairing data not yet available due to lag)
Stream app detects null response and retries by checking the DynamoDB global table for the pairing data
Verify the stream app eventually publishes to the aggregated topic after successful global table retry
Global table returns pairing data on retry - stream app completes the join and publishes aggregated event
Aggregated message is published after the retry cycle - no events are permanently dropped due to the COA lag
